name: versioned_folders
description: Versioned file trees with drafts, immutable versions, and an atomic current pointer

tools.name: versioned_folders
tools.description: VersionedFolders toolset master switch — every versioned_folder_* tool additionally requires its own key

tools.name: versioned_folder_get_current
tools.description: Read which version a folder currently publishes

tools.name: versioned_folder_create_draft
tools.description: Create an editable draft from a version

tools.name: versioned_folder_list_files
tools.description: List files in a draft or version

tools.name: versioned_folder_read_file
tools.description: Read one text file from a draft or version

tools.name: versioned_folder_apply_changes
tools.description: Write and delete files in a draft as one atomic batch

tools.name: versioned_folder_diff
tools.description: Compare a draft against its base, current, or a version

tools.name: versioned_folder_finalize
tools.description: Freeze a draft into an immutable version

tools.name: versioned_folder_publish
tools.description: Point a folder's current at an existing version

tools.name: versioned_folder_discard_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft without creating a version
